description: Dependencies in other documents (L2, L3, L6, boundary table). A dependency in a file the host lets the reader open is added, with its document's document-scoped constraints (scope=document or above the first heading) and the section constraints of its own section. A file that does not exist is missing (or denied, when the host cannot tell), a file outside what the host allows is denied (or unread), and either makes the view incomplete. The source map must map the carried blocks to other.smd and keep mapping the document's own lines after them.
